verdict.rationale: Swell provides a real developer toolkit: official Node/PHP SDKs, a CLI (`swell app init`, `push`) for scaffolding apps/themes, custom models/functions/webhooks for extending the platform, and theme distribution/upgrade/duplicate features tied to storefront apps like Proxima. However, evidence for a formal app review or marketplace submission/distribution process (beyond theme distribution) is thin, and probes show no discoverable OpenAPI/llms.txt for programmatic SDK generation. Missing for 10: explicit third-party app marketplace/review workflow, broader language SDK coverage, and independent verification of the CLI/SDK experience.
